操作节点已改变，请重新选择: The operation history has changed. Select a node again.
配置根节点必须是映射: The configuration root must be a mapping
与现有文件的大小写冲突，请使用原路径: The letter case conflicts with an existing file. Use its original path.
多个导入文件指向同一路径，请取消选择或更改路径: Multiple imports target the same path. Uncheck a file or change its target.
工程已切换，请重新选择导入文件: The project has changed. Select the import files again.
已恢复保存节点的配置 · 可撤销，保存后才写入磁盘: Saved point restored · Undo is available; save to write changes to disk
选择一个操作完成后的状态: Select the state after an operation
保存时自动创建 · 重启后仍可用: Created on save · Available after restart
第一次保存修改时，会自动记录保存前后的完整配置。: The first save records the full configuration before and after your changes.
最多保留本次打开期间的 200 个操作；连续输入会合并成一个节点。: Retains up to 200 operations in this session. Continuous typing is grouped into one node.
保留最近 30 个保存节点，合计最多 256 MB。节点只包含 YAML 配置。: Retains up to 30 saved points and 256 MB total. Points contain YAML configuration only.
选择左侧节点查看变化: Select a node on the left to see changes
查看历史，放心修改: Review history and edit with confidence
先查看差异，再选择回到哪个节点。: Inspect the diff before choosing a restore point.
点击保存才会写入工程；回退本身也可以撤销或前进。: Save to write changes to the project. You can undo or move forward after restoring.
选中节点预览差异，一次回到需要的状态: Select a node, review its diff and restore the desired state
修改、导入和 Agent 操作会记录在这里。: Edits, imports and Agent operations appear here.
导出当前编辑内容，包括尚未保存的修改。: Export current editor contents, including unsaved edits.
原工程不会因此被覆盖。: The original project will not be overwritten.
同时包含工程里的图片、着色器和其他资源: Include project images, shaders and other assets
选择少量文件用于分享或合并；选择全部配置并包含资源，可导出完整配置包。不会包含玩: Select a few files to share or merge, or all configuration with assets for a complete package. Excludes player data, editor model keys, Agent conversations and restore history. Original configuration values are retained.
存在 YAML 错误，请先修复再导出。: has YAML errors. Fix them before exporting.
ZIP 保留工程相对路径，方便再次导入和合并。: ZIP preserves project-relative paths for later import and merging.
已导入 {0} 个配置 · 可从历史节点整体回退，尚未写入磁盘: Imported {0} configurations · Restore the batch from history; not saved to disk yet
把已有配置带进当前工程: Bring existing configuration into this project
支持多个 YAML 文件、ZIP 配置包或整个配置目录。: Supports multiple YAML files, a ZIP package or a configuration folder.
先选择文件、处理冲突，再一次性应用。: Select files, resolve conflicts and apply them together.
这里只导入 YAML；图片可从资源库导入，完整资源包可从导出页生成。: This imports YAML only. Import images through Assets; export full resource packages from the Export tab.
按组件 ID 合并；没有 ID 的列表整体处理。应用后可回退。: Merges by component ID; lists without IDs are treated as whole values. You can restore after applying.
选择文件、预览差异，再应用到工程: Select files, review the diff and apply to the project
